title: World Bloom — Dear My Fellows — Episode7 As Long as We're Together

meta.Episode: Episode7 — As Long as We're Together
meta.Event Outline: Having trained with three famous troupes, Wonderlands×Showtime has certainly grown. While checking for any changes in their SEKAI, they hear of a problem with the tree, and are shown a world where they are each chasing their own dreams.

rows.Line: A few days later
Practice Area

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: Alright, once again...

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: Kazamatsuri here will be performing as a guest star in this show.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to putting on a great show with all of you. It'll only be for a short time, but thank you for having me!

rows.Speaker: Troupe Members
rows.Line: Thank you for joining us!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I get to perform alongside Ms. Kazamatsuri... Who knows when or if I'll have this kind of opportunity again.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (So, I have to learn as much as I possibly can from her during these practices!)

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line: Next, we'll be doing the opening singing scene. Kazamatsuri, Kusanagi, please get ready.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I promise to do my best...!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Alright, shall we?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The others and I are thinking about going out for dinner after practice, Nene. Would you like to join us...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, umm... I was actually hoping to work on the scene I had trouble with today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I really appreciate you inviting me...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
I understand...
But we should go out together sometime!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'm not supposed to be pointing this blade at you! I know that...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, that didn't sound right...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Natalie's already prepared to bear that sin.
So...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I'm not supposed to be pointing this blade at you. I know that. But...”

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Good morni—

rows.Speaker: Amemiya
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough practice for today!
Nice work, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Troupe Members
rows.Line: Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, I still don't have a good grasp of my character's feelings...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Mr. Amemiya even said how I was moving like a robot. That's probably why...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Alright, after this, I'll really dissect this script and...)
se_walk_women_005_1

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Nice work out there, Nene.
Are you free after this?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I was hoping that you and I could have dinner together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, with me...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes! We still haven't had a chance to catch up after not seeing each other for so long.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I really appreciate it, Ms. Kazamatsuri.
But I...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Working hard is important, but it's also important to not work too hard...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The show doesn't open for quite a while, so you should give yourself a chance to relax.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Taking breaks is a key part of putting on good shows, remember?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Right...
Then, maybe just today.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Wonderful. In that case, let's go!
Several dozen minutes later
Park Cafe

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't know this cafe had terrace seating...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes, I came here a lot when I was still living in Japan!

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
I even used to come here with Amemiya.
I remember us having heated discussions about which effects and such would make a song really stand out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting. I'm having a hard time imagining you and Mr. Amemiya arguing like that...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Really? We used to a lot.
He obsesses over the smallest things, you know? I ended up getting worked up often.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hehe. I guess every troupe is the same.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I was still with my old troupe, Tsukasa and Rui used to argue a lot.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You've grown so much since then, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Remember that show you had me watch when you were still with Wonderlands×Showtime?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I feel like your singing and acting skills have leveled up quite a lot since then.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Th-Thank you very much...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I still need a lot of work.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
You think so?
Even though you were chosen for the lead in that last show?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yes, I got to play the lead.
But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It only went well because I had the help of so many others.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which is why I believe I still need a lot of work...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You really haven't changed since then...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Remember that conversation we had about me introducing you to Amemiya's troupe? That day, we chose to meet at a cafe not dissimilar to this one.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I remember...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We met right after Wonderlands×Showtime disbanded, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: While I was looking for a new troupe to join, I just happened to run into you during one of your stays in Japan. And you took the time to listen to what I was going through...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. That feels like an eternity ago.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You were also really desperate back then, Nene...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You were doing everything you could to make your dream a reality. But...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Compared to back then, I feel like you're pushing yourself even harder now.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I don't think I've changed at all since then...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because I'm still lacking so much...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: You are...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I lack the necessary skills, knowledge, resolve and so many other things...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even today, I was called out on all the mistakes I made while singing and moving around.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But... Even though things are hard for me right now, I want to make my dream come true.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want to show my friends that I can keep going on my own. And I don't want them to hog all the glory. That's what's driving me.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Nene...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The thing is, Rui, Tsukasa and Emu have all made huge progress towards making their own dreams come true...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Rui in particular since he was just asked to join a troupe overseas. And he's going.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Oh, he's going overseas...?
That's pretty incredible.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It is...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No matter how hard I work... No matter how much progress I make, the gap between me and my friends keeps on increasing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Which means, in order to catch up to them, I have to keep doing what I can.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'll have to work two or three times harder than them if I want my dream to come true...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I have to do this.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I actually believe otherwise...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Yes, in terms of setting out into the world, Nene, you may be right. You're still probably missing a few things.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: But I don't believe that your skill level is so low that you need to work this much harder than everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I have to think that the others in your troupe feel the same way. Otherwise, you wouldn't have been asked to play the lead.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I really appreciate you saying that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Now I see...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: No matter how much praise or reassurance others provide, you never think you're doing enough.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Things must be really hard for you right now.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I know that feeling. When I first started performing overseas, I went through the same thing...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Even after I'd become better and started winning big roles, I kept running circles in my head thinking that I was still missing something crucial.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Really? I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line:
Really. Then it dawned on me...
As important as it was to keep pushing myself to become better...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: The way I was going, I'd eventually push myself past the point of breaking.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I don't want you to do that to yourself, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ms. Kazamatsuri...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So...
How did you manage to overcome that...?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Well, I...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I remember thinking about the people I trusted the most and imagining what they would say if they saw me perform...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: I figured that if they would say I was doing just fine, then I shouldn't be quite so hard on myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The people you trusted the most...

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Hehe. What a lovely smile...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: It feels like it's been so long since I saw you actually smile, Nene. And that smile is as adorable as I remember it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: A-Adorable...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Still, you have a point...
I think I'm feeling a bit more relaxed now.

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: Really? That's great to hear...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This is so strange...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I don't want the others from Wonderlands×Showtime to get too far ahead of me, but they're also the ones who are keeping me going.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (If they saw me now, I'm sure they'd talk about just how much I've grown and improved...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (That doesn't mean I can leave my shortcomings as they are. But at the same time...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I guess I can feel a little proud of myself now...)
